schema: docs/oracle/identity/game-identity.schema.json (camera descriptor; framing, collision, transition and body are study notes, not yet schema fields)
note: Hand estimates from knowledge of the games and developer talks, not captures (source: estimate). owned = in Evan's Steam library. style = we may learn from it; expression = we never copy it.

games.name: Manor Lords
games.why: Zooms from the city view down to walking the village as a person.

camera.framing: Board camera at height; walk mode behind the lord.
camera.transition: Continuous zoom, same world, pitch tied to height.

lessons.lesson: One camera and one world from board to body.

lessons.never: Its UI, models and village layouts.

games.name: Valheim
games.why: Owned survival game with a calm behind-the-shoulder camera.

camera.framing: Slightly right of centre, free orbit, zoomable boom.

lessons.lesson: Zoomable boom distance the player can set once.

games.name: Enshrouded
games.why: Owned; a modern over-the-shoulder camera with building.

lessons.lesson: Shoulder offset grows only when aiming or building.

games.name: Sable
games.why: Owned; a gentle exploration camera and lovely climbing and cape motion.
games.body: Cape and cloth secondary motion; lean on the bike.

lessons.lesson: Secondary motion on cloth sells a simple character.

games.name: Fall Guys
games.why: Owned; physical comedy bodies loved by kids.

camera.transition: Round preview flyover then drop in behind.

games.body: Wobbly physics, squash on landing, ragdoll stumbles.

lessons.lesson: Wobble and squash beat realism for kids.

games.name: Bluey: The Videogame
games.why: Owned kids' game; children barely steer the camera.

lessons.lesson: Let the camera frame the room for small children.

lessons.never: Bluey characters, the show's art and voices.

games.name: PAW Patrol World
games.why: Owned open-world kids' game.

games.name: State of Decay 2
games.why: Owned; switch which survivor you are in a community.

camera.transition: Character switch from the base menu.

lessons.lesson: You can inhabit any member of a community.

games.name: The Alters
games.why: Owned; walking a base and talking to versions of yourself.

games.name: Strange Brigade
games.why: Owned co-op shooter; a classic aiming shoulder cam.

lessons.lesson: Shoulder offset exists for aiming; we have none.

games.name: Marvel Rivals
games.why: Owned hero shooter.

games.name: Super Mario Odyssey
games.why: The reference chase camera for kids' 3D platforming.

camera.framing: Behind and above, lag with dead zone, auto recentre.
camera.transition: Capture: dive into another creature and become it.

games.body: Lean, squash, look-at, huge expressive clip set.

lessons.lesson: Becoming another creature as a quick, joyful transition.

lessons.never: Mario, Cappy and all Nintendo characters and sounds.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
games.why: Points of interest and head look-at.

lessons.lesson: Head look-at as a marker-free signal.

games.name: Sky: Children of the Light
games.why: Phone-first third person: one thumb moves, the camera follows.

lessons.lesson: Touch anywhere to move; no on-screen stick at rest.

games.name: Astro Bot
games.why: Tight, readable chase camera and lively small body.

lessons.lesson: A small character with many tiny reactions feels alive.

games.name: A Short Hike
games.why: Indie, gentle, kid-friendly exploration.

lessons.lesson: Simple model plus look-at reads well at low resolution.

games.name: God of War (2018)
games.why: Close shoulder camera; whole game in one shot.

camera.framing: Character left of frame, world opens to the right.
camera.transition: No cuts: every transition is the play camera.

lessons.lesson: Hand-back on the play camera; never cut away.

games.name: Resident Evil 4
games.why: Popularised the over-the-shoulder camera, for aiming.

lessons.lesson: Shoulder offset is an aiming tool.

games.name: Journey
games.why: Gentle automatic camera and scarf motion.

lessons.lesson: A scarf or tail can carry a lot of feeling.

games.name: The Last of Us Part II
games.why: Motion matching at AAA scale; out of our reach.
games.body: Motion matching on large capture sets.

lessons.lesson: Know the ceiling; do not chase it.
